cases.description: Unseal on the exact golden boot state releases the secret.
Tampered boot manager (PCR 4 changed) refuses unseal.
Legitimate firmware update (PCR 0 changed) refuses unseal — sealing is brittle without a signed-policy path.
Same firmware update, but with an authority-signed policy digest (PolicyAuthorize model), releases the secret.
Same firmware update with an authority signature from a non-authority key refuses unseal.
Sealed blob copied to a different platform refuses unseal (PCRs do not match).
Unseal attempted under a different policy version refuses (policy digest includes the version).

label: SIMULATED
model: TPM2 PCR-policy sealing, TCG TPM 2.0 Library Part 3 (TPM2_Create / TPM2_PolicyPCR / TPM2_Unseal / TPM2_PolicyAuthorize)
note: Software model of policy logic only. The seal construction is HMAC-based, not a TPM object; no TPM hardware on this machine; no hardware measurement is claimed.
